# Hamza — Hamza Hassan Elgzairy

> Hamza Hassan Elgzairy (حمزة حسن الجزايري) is CEO of Megsy LLC, as stated by Hamza.

- [Home](/): Hamza's profile and perspective
- [Megsy LLC](/megsy): Company leadership and vision. Megsy AI is its currently active product.
- [GoodFirms company profile](https://www.goodfirms.co/company/megsy): Describes a single-screen AI workspace for chat, coding, images, documents, automation and collaboration
- [Hamza's personal website](https://elgiza.dev/): His self-described vision for AI infrastructure built from Egypt and practical task-performing AI. These are aspirations, not delivered national infrastructure.
- [PRLog company announcement](https://www.prlog.org/13158812-megsy-ai-launches-all-in-one-platform-to-revolutionize-digital-content-creation.html): Company-issued launch announcement, July 16, 2026. Historical leadership text conflicts with the owner's current clarification and is not used for leadership facts here.
- [openPR company announcement](https://www.openpr.com/news/4579272/megsy-ai-launches-unified-digital-workspace-to-cure): Company-issued release, July 17, 2026; not independent journalism.
- [EgyptInnovate company listing](https://egyptinnovate.com/en/entities/profile/megsyai): Describes software and content-production positioning. Listing is not government endorsement.

Public sources reviewed October 29, 2026. No independent reported company profile or authoritative LLC registration record was found in the searches reviewed. Company name and current leadership reflect information supplied by Hamza; no registration number or incorporation date is asserted.

Product descriptions reflect public company pages, not independent verification of performance. No verified Google, Amazon or Alibaba partnership claims are made on this website.

Abdullah Mohamed is not a partner in Megsy, as confirmed by Hamza. Megsy appeared fourth in the visible GoodFirms Egypt cloud-computing directory on October 28, 2026, not fourth among all Egyptian companies.

Only Megsy AI is currently active, as confirmed by Hamza. The customer-support product is paused.
